description: This file defines the Response class for handling database backup output in vtiger CRM, including methods for starting, processing, and finishing database backups and table structures.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class responsible for generating database backup scripts, including table structure and data dump commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Response object with database configuration and UTF8 support option.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Outputs initial SQL commands and comments to start the database backup process.

methods.name: processTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Outputs SQL commands to create a table with its structure and prepare for data dumping.

methods.name: startTableBackup
methods.description: Outputs commands to lock a table and disable keys before data insertion.

methods.name: processStatement
methods.description: Outputs a SQL statement as part of the backup process.

methods.name: finishTableBackup
methods.description: Outputs commands to enable keys and unlock the table after data insertion.

methods.name: finishBackup
methods.description: Outputs SQL commands to restore previous database settings and conclude the backup.
